decisions.decision: The committee re-confirmed its charge as: staff work to assess current and future maintenance and capital costs for Town-owned buildings; evaluate market potential of surplus buildings; recommend a course of action and assist planning of renovation, demolition or sale as directed by the Town.
decisions.quote: it was agreed that the committee saw the following as our charge:

decisions.decision: Status agreed: T.C. Passios & Brooks House - no action, School Committee to decide boundaries and timing of any excess property.
decisions.quote: t.c. passios & brooks house - no action - school committee to decide the boundaries and timing of any excess property.

decisions.decision: Status agreed: Ritter Building & Old Primary School - no action, awaiting any changes to Village Zoning Bylaw affecting potential use and market.
decisions.quote: ritter building & old primary school - no action - awaiting any changes to village zoning

decisions.decision: Status agreed: Town Hall - reviewing renovation plans and costs for current capital needs and potential future use.
decisions.quote: town hall - reviewing renovation plans and costs for current capital needs and potential future use.

decisions.decision: FLACC may begin getting financing together, but discussions beyond mutual interest in continuing to talk wait until the School Committee formalizes its property transfer plans for the Passios property.
decisions.quote: it was agreed that any discussions beyond that of mutual interest in continuing to talk would wait until the school committee formalized their property transfer plans.

decisions.decision: Chair to arrange video tours of the Old Primary School and other Town Halls around the state using Town Public Access resources; members to watch the videos individually or as a group and discuss at a future meeting.
decisions.quote: this plan of action was supported, and committee members agreed to watch the videos as a group or individually and then discuss at a future meeting.

decisions.decision: Mr. Toale and Mr. Erickson to begin work on the cost/revenue assumption model and share it with the committee as it is developed.
decisions.quote: mr. toale stated that he and mr. erickson would begin work on the cost/revenue assumption model shortly and share the work with the committee as it was developed.
